speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Dermatitis.

The skin biopsy showing intraepidermal edema and widened intercellular spaces, combined with the clinical exam of erythematous, scaly, and crusted lesions on your arms, is consistent with inflammation of the skin. Given your lack of fever and normal vital signs, a systemic infection is unlikely. Is your itching worse at night or when your hands are wet?
